message: できること

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, Sakura-kun, I'm counting on you again today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Melilot
message: 「My errands look like they'll take a while this time, so I've scheduled the library to be closed tomorrow and the day after.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'll need your help again starting next week.」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay...」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, please take care on your trip.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, thank you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Sigh.」
She even celebrated my birthday the other day, so I thought Melilot-san and I had gotten closer, but...
Even so, she still hasn't told me the reason why she goes out.
Honestly, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't curious.
Above all, if it comes down to whether or not she trusts me, that makes it bother me even more.

name: Synn
message: 「Is something like this really all I can help her with...」
I want to be of more use to Melilot-san.
I want to earn the kind of trust she gives only to me.
And then, I want Melilot-san to tell me what she's keeping secret in her own words.
...Is it presumptuous of me to think like this?

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, Melilot-san trusted me enough to leave this to me, so I have to do a good job!」
Even so, right now, all I can do is what's within my power.
The librarian, and the acting librarian.
Because that's the relationship between Melilot-san and me right now.

name: Synn
message: 「I can't find any information on Re-Crea...」
There aren't many visitors today, so I can focus on searching through the materials.
Though, as usual, I still haven't found the documents I'm looking for.

name: Synn
message: 「...That's right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe in the archive stacks or somewhere...」
I've heard that old documents and valuable books are stored there.
Old records regarding Re-Crea might be kept in that collection too.
Of course, even as the acting librarian, I'm still a student, so I'm prohibited from entering.
Still, right now, Melilot-san wouldn't be around to scold me.
And I have more than enough time to look for the key.
If I can quickly track down a lead to resolve Re-Crea, it wouldn't just be for Melilot-san's sake, it'd be for everyone's too……

name: Synn
message: 「……No, I shouldn't」
That only sounds like an excuse to mask my own curiosity.
More than anything, it would mean betraying Melilot-san's trust.
I just need to focus on doing what I can do……

name: Sengen'in
message: 「……Oh, my」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Filling in for that librarian again today, I see」

name: Synn
message: 「Sengenin-sensei……」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's not as though it'll boost your school record, either」

name: Synn
message: 「It's nothing like that」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Then perhaps it's just hypocrisy on your part as Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「……What business do you have here, Sensei」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Hehe…… I was just wondering how you've been doing, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't think that's any of your concern, Sensei……」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Well, isn't that harsh」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Is a teacher not allowed to worry about her student?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「If you're having trouble because the substitute duties were forced on you, you're always welcome to talk to me about it」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm doing this of my own free will」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Oh, is that so」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Here I was, completely convinced you were being deceived or something」

name: Synn
message: 「Deceived…… Why would Melilot-san ever do something like that……」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「So you don't find anything strange about that librarian at all, do you」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's……」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Hasn't anything ever struck you as odd?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Who that librarian really is, and what she's truly trying to do...」
I don't even need Ms. Sengenin to point it out to me.
It's obvious that Ms. Melilot is keeping something secret.
Where she goes when she heads out, her background, the hidden meaning behind her usual words and actions--there's a mountain of things I want to know.
But that's only because I want to be closer to her and help her out...

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Don't you want to know?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「About her... There's quite a lot, isn't there?」

name: Synn
message: 「...I don't want to do anything that would be a bother to Ms. Melilot.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's the exact opposite.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Coming to understand her will actually help her.」

name: Synn
message: 「Help her...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Not telling you anything is her own form of kindness, trying not to cause you unnecessary trouble.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「And you're simply taking advantage of that kindness.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Of course, if you say you'd rather keep things just the way they are, that's fine too.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「However, Sakura-kun.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You want to be of help to her...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「...Am I wrong?」
Why did I volunteer to be the acting librarian?
Why do I want to stay by Ms. Melilot's side?
Something like that doesn't even require thinking about.
The Student Council and the Crusaders have nothing to do with it; the feelings inside me are everything.

name: Synn
message: 「I want to... be of help to Ms. Melilot...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I see...」
Ms. Sengenin's eerily pale hand slowly touches my shoulder.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Just as I'd expect from you, Sakura-kun. I knew you'd say that.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Being able to act for someone else's sake. It's a truly wonderful thing.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you know about Melilot-san, Sensei...?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Ah, right... It's only natural that you'd wonder」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's really quite simple, though」
Gently stroking my arm, Sensei's hand pulls away.

name: Sengen'in
message: 「She and I are cut from the same cloth」

name: Synn
message: 「The same...?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I came to this land for much the same reason she did」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Besides, I want to help her too」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You'll understand right away once you go see her」

name: Synn
message: 「Go see her? I don't even know where she is, you know?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「That won't be a problem」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Come to Finis Tower tomorrow」

name: Synn
message: 「To the tower?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Yes」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I'll have a guide waiting, so all you need to do is follow them」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「After that, once you arrive, just tell her how you feel, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「How I feel...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「If things go well, we might be able to resolve all sorts of problems」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「For example, yes...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「The Demon, perhaps...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Heheh...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I'm looking forward to seeing you show the kind of power I expect from you」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, how do you know about the Demons, Sensei...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Everything will become clear tomorrow」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「See you then...」
So Sensei Sengenin knows something too.
About us, and about the Crusaders.
Thinking about it like that, she seems like an even more mysterious person than Melilot.
Still, if Sensei were an enemy, there's no way she'd tell me something like this...
In that case, I can't afford not to accept this invitation.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be able to help Melilot out, right...」
There's a lot on my mind, but once tomorrow comes, I'll understand everything.
This time, I'll finally be able to do something for Melilot myself...!
